title: Hoja de ánimas · notas
description: The ánimas' sheet as just animas serves it (output/reports/animas/, written again on each load by animasSheet in vite.config.ts): an ánima's design beside what the game has, with its notes in the rail on the right, written, edited and closed there; the Notas page gathers them all. It writes to output/reports/animas/notes-scratch.json (?notas=scratch), never to docs/anima-notes.json, and empties it at the end.

steps.eval: fetch('/__animas/notas?archivo=scratch', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ notes: [{ id: 'n-a1', entry: 'papagato', name: 'Papagato', text: 'La tabla de habilidades no dice cuántas heridas hacen falta para el golpe crítico. Ponlo en el diseño.', status: 'hecha', created: '2026-11-20T09:10:00Z', closed: '2026-11-20T09:40:00Z', reply: 'Añadido en § Signature: el golpe crítico salta con 3 heridas abiertas, con el ejemplo de una ronda.' }, { id: 'n-a2', entry: 'duos', name: 'Dúos', text: 'Falta una pareja para Dadaísta que no sea con Matemágico.', status: 'abierta', created: '2026-11-20T09:20:00Z' }] }) })

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('#notes [data-draft]'); t.focus(); t.value = 'Ronroneo cura poco para lo que cuesta: compáralo con la cura de Matemágico.'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.caption: Papagato with its notes on the right: the one just written (Ctrl/⌘ + Enter), open, and an older one closed with the anima skill's reply; ✎ 1 beside Papagato and Dúos in the list

steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelector('#notes .note.abierta [data-act="editar"]').click(); const t = document.querySelector('#notes [data-edit]'); t.value = 'Ronroneo cura poco para lo que cuesta (2 de maná): compáralo con la cura de Matemágico y con Atacar.'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.caption: Editing a note in place: Guardar (Ctrl/⌘ + Enter) or Cancelar (Esc)
The note saved with its new text and the time it was edited; Borrar asks once more before deleting
Notas: every open note on the sheet, by ánima and page, each linking to its page (Todas also shows the closed ones)

steps.eval: fetch('/__animas/notas?archivo=scratch', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ notes: [] }) })
